text:
Nina: quick idea 94 add a lightweight "preview" + "apply" flow for runtime flags with SLO checks.
Omar: sounds good. what signals should block an apply? p50/p95/p99 + error-rate?
Nina: p99 primary, error-rate secondary. block if p99 increases > 1% or errors > 0.3% over 5m.
Lee: we also need a cost estimate. a flag could switch models and double token cost. preview should include est_cost_delta.
Nina: API sketch: POST /v1/flags/{id}/apply with body {"cohort":100,"mode":"dry|apply","force":false,"reason":"..."}.
Omar: prefer POST /v1/flags/{id}/preview for preview; apply consumes preview_id to prove you checked.
Lee: telemetry: counters config_preview_total{outcome="ok|warn|err"} and config_apply_total{result="applied|blocked|forced"}.
SRE: avoid high-cardinality labels like preview_id. keep preview_id in logs/traces only. metrics should use preview_bucket=small|full.
ops-bot: created ticket CFG-777 for preview+apply flow and guardrail thresholds  assigned to @Nina and @SRE.
Nina: UX: console should show a small banner when an apply is blocked with a link to the preview diff and recommended cohorts.
Omar: override policy: no self-serve force for 24h after a new flag lands. ops must supply ticket and reason to force.
Lee: implement a dry_prefetch mode to warm caches without switching routes: apply?mode=dry_prefetch.
SRE: also add an alert: 3 failed applies for same flag within 1h -> page oncall.
Nina: timeline: API + basic telemetry by end of week, console changes next sprint. follow-up in CFG-777. :rocket:
